equity.level_reason: No social-position dimension is analyzed; comparisons are by week and U.S. region (geography). Age appears only implicitly through an external comparison with adults aged ≥70 years.

level_alternative.reason: Nursing home residence (congregate living of older adults) could be read as a social-position descriptor, though it is not framed as such.

ev.q: more than eight times the peak weekly rate of 0.87 per 10,000 among all U.S. adults aged ≥70 years

equity.equity_measurement: Only facility-level aggregate data; region is geography, not an SPD; no person-level demographics.

notes: Comparisons with earlier seasons' peaks and with U.S. adults aged ≥70 years use cited external figures (the 'more than eight times' ratio); main results are side-by-side weekly and regional values, so scale is null. Mid-p exact CIs are a CI method, not a test used for conclusions.
view_issues: Discussion gives the peak infection rate as 133.8 'per 100,000' though results use per 10,000, and states coverage 'reached 41.5% overall' while results and tables give 40.5%.
